text.metric: For germination, provide steady warmth of at least 21°C. Heated-house planting may begin in April; unheated cover or outdoor planting must wait for sufficiently warm conditions.
text.imperial: For germination, provide steady warmth of at least 70°F. Heated-house planting may begin in April; unheated cover or outdoor planting must wait for sufficiently warm conditions.

aubergine.reason: RHS aubergine guidance specifies at least 21°C/70°F for germination; clarify the stage and use paired prose.

coverage.aubergine: All seven distinct source problem groups retained. Combined wilt/blight label remains pending disease-identity normalisation, but proof seeks diagnosis rather than promising a fixed three-year cure. Whitefly monitoring separated from control with organic biological guidance. Soil/care/harvest preserve warmth, roots, support, optional branching/fruit thinning and glossy harvest. No blanket five-fruit limit: crop load follows variety and desired size. Early covered versus outdoor routes and optional seed soaking considered; soaking omitted as nonessential and kept in master.
coverage.artichoke_globe: Six distinct inline problems plus mice already documented in the seed route. Aphid insecticide replaced in full with organic cultural control. Soil/care combine water, feeding, mulch and winter protection, while preserving crown renewal and shoot selection. Harvest keeps main/side-head timing and weak-first-year restraint. Caption already covers offset season, depth and seed route; note preserves not over-taking suckers. Extra spacing qualified by soil and kept as unit pair.
coverage.artichoke_jerusalem: All three actual source problems retained without inventing extra rows. Slug pellets and phoxim/diazinon soil-grub prescriptions replaced in full with organic observation, removal and harvest timing. Soil/care retain weed control, earthing, water, support and optional feeding/flower removal. Harvest and tips cover hardy winter standing, saved planting stock and persistent regrowth. Caption already owns late-winter/spring block planting and avoiding shade; complete sowing note is intentionally empty. All three varieties retained.
